teacher.stepsDescription: Here is what to expect when you apply to become a course teacher.
steps: Create your account
Start the course-teacher registration form. New users create an account as part of the process.
Complete your application
Provide your personal details, teaching category, subject, method, qualifications, and availability.
Complete the subject assessment
Answer questions connected to your selected subject and submit your application for review.
Wait for the review decision
The Academy reviews submitted applications. Course-teaching tools are available after approval.
afterSteps: Set its subject, level, language, objectives, pricing, and estimated duration.
Build the course from lessons and learning materials using the teacher tools.
Review enrollment and progress, and communicate with enrolled learners through available platform tools.
teacher.finalHeading: Ready to bring your expertise to learners?
teacher.finalDescription: Start the application when you are ready. You can also explore live tutoring as a separate teaching path.

benefits.details: Choose your timezone, weekly availability, advance booking time, and the minimum sessions you can take each week.

benefits.title: Set a clear session offer

benefits.details: Your public profile presents the session duration and price you provide. Students can review your offer before choosing to book.

liveTutor.stepsEyebrow: From first step to first booking
liveTutor.stepsDescription: A transparent look at the application and the work that follows approval.
steps: Create an account
New tutors create a Barakah Academy account before submitting their application.
Describe your teaching
Choose your category, subjects, teaching level, languages, and session offer.
Set availability and profile
Add your timezone, weekly schedule, tutor bio, approach, and profile information.
Complete scenario questions
Answer practical questions about supporting students and submit your application for review.
After approval
Your public tutor profile can be shown to students. Keep availability current and manage bookings from your tutor workspace.

aboutPage.heading: Inclusive learning built for real life.
aboutPage.description: Barakah Academy exists to help students and families learn with confidence, in the language they understand best, with teachers and tutors who are genuinely invested in their progress.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To make high-quality education accessible, affordable, and practical for learners across different backgrounds and locations.

teaching.title: How we teach
teaching.text: We combine expert teachers, live tutors, subject-based courses, and supportive mentorship to keep learning engaging and results-focused.

impact.title: Why it matters
impact.text: Learning should move people forward — in school, in work, in language confidence, and in the ability to create a better future.
